Email api-info@metrc.com for access to a Lab facility for the evaluation.
To POST /labtests/v2/record in the state of California, you must work with the Licensee's LiMS system via the API.

All the information that is required for the request for POST /labtests/v2/record to function is found in the results of the request GET /labtests/v2/types. How this will be set up to return a 200 is for your team to determine.
This is not an easy POST in the State of California; it requires 50 to over 100 tests to be conducted on each sample per POST /labtests/v2/record
The API Documentation example for the POST /labtests/v2/record will not work for the state of California but should be a guide for the format of the request.
